hook_line: THE MAN WHO BUILT ALEXA NOW RUNS BOSTON DYNAMICS

hook_stat.sub: Boston Dynamics' history — and Prasad is only its third chief executive

news_summary: Ranchi-born Rohit Prasad, the speech scientist who built Amazon's Alexa, became chief executive of Boston Dynamics on October 7, 2026.
payoff: Hyundai plans to deploy Atlas humanoids at its Georgia plant from 2028, with capacity to produce 30,000 robots a year.
